cause: The blog build's link rule allowed (J4.T4) kept its own inline same-origin regex ^/(?!/), which refused only a second slash; a backslash or a tab after the leading slash passed and browsers read both as //host, an open redirect (CWE-601). It was a second decider beside SiteRelativeUrl, the one site-relative rule.
context: Found by the rc-4 reviewers in the J4/J5 blog build; allowed() at build-blog.mjs:19 is the one link decider
expected: A site-relative link is one slash never followed by a backslash, a slash, a control or a whitespace character; both probes are refused
repro: cd frontend && node -e 'const allowed=(h)=>/^\/(?!\/)/.test(h)||h.startsWith("#");for(const h of ["/\\evil.example/path","/\t/evil.example"])console.log(allowed(h))' prints true true, exit 0 (rule copied from build-blog.mjs:19; sha c8d0ebf)
solution: REBUILD allowed: it calls SiteRelativeUrl.safeParse, imported with HttpUrl; the inline regex is deleted and no second same-origin regex remains. The link-rule table gained a backslash row and a tab row, each asserting the exact stderr and exit 1.
symptom: A backslash or a tab after the leading slash passes the site-relative rule; browsers read both as //host
title: Blog link rule admits protocol-relative redirects (CWE-601)

cause: the media-file rule was decided twice, differently, in blog-posts.mjs and build-blog.mjs; the reader accepted any existing file as image
context: blog-posts.mjs:38,71 and build-blog.mjs:24-30,36 each decide 'a media file of the post folder'; found by the rc-4 reviewers
expected: One check, owned by the post reader, admits only an image or clip file of the post folder; the build uses it; index.md and ../shot.png are refused
repro: cd frontend && post with 'image: index.md', node scripts/build-blog.mjs --posts <dir> --dist <dir with index.html> exits 0 and <dist>/blog/<slug>/index.md exists (sha c8d0ebf)
solution: REBUILD: isMedia in the post reader is the one check and the build uses it
symptom: A front-matter image: index.md passes the reader (any existing file) and the build copies the raw Markdown as the share image; ../ traversal and the image copy have no test
title: Media-file rule decided twice, differently; front-matter image index.md is copied

cause: useDocumentSeo ran on every render with post?.title ?? '', blanking the head while the index loaded and on an unknown slug
context: BlogPostPage.tsx:28; found by the rc-4 reviewers; fixed in the sibling tree
expected: The head keeps a non-empty title while the post is unresolved or missing
repro: reviewer probe: render BlogPostPage at /blog/nope, then read document.title: prints '' (sha c8d0ebf)
solution: PostView mounts only for a resolved post and alone sets the head and fetches the body; net +2 because a hook cannot be called conditionally
symptom: Rendered at /blog/nope the page leaves document.title as an empty string
title: Post page blanks the document head before the post resolves

cause: the default og:image was read by a bare template.match(...)[1] outside the exactly-once rule
context: build-blog.mjs:141,150 read the template default og:image by a bare template.match(...)[1]; J5.T4 note requires the exactly-once rule
expected: The build exits 1 with 'template: og:image must match exactly once'
repro: cd frontend && strip the og:image meta from dist/index.html, node scripts/build-blog.mjs --posts <one clean post> --dist <dist> prints TypeError Cannot read properties of null, exit 1 (sha c8d0ebf)
solution: one hoisted read with ?.[1] ?? '' and setHead's existing check names the missing tag
symptom: A template without og:image dies with 'Cannot read properties of null' instead of naming the tag
title: Default og:image read bypasses the exactly-once template rule

cause: the poster-order case ran the CLI twice (and the no-post case twice), so one case paid several spawns and exceeded vitest's 5000 ms under load
context: buildBlog.test.ts:185 runs the CLI three times; flaky gate in the rc merge gate
expected: The case finishes well inside the default timeout with one build over a fixture holding the three poster variants
repro: rc merge gate run on 2026-11-07, case 'picks the poster among webp, png, jpg' failed: timed out after 6247 ms (sha c8d0ebf)
solution: one CLI build per case: the poster variants share one fixture post and the no-post cases are split
symptom: On 2026-11-07 the case took 6247 ms against vitest's 5000 ms default under load; the whole file takes about 2 s at load 3.5
title: Poster-order test spawns three builds and exceeds the 5000 ms timeout

cause: marked.parse wraps any error thrown in a renderer in onError, which appends a report line
context: Errors thrown in the renderer reach the user through marked, which appends its report line (build-blog.mjs:68)
expected: stderr is exactly '<slug>: link: "<href>" is not http(s), site-relative or #'
repro: cd frontend && post body '[x](page.html)', node scripts/build-blog.mjs --posts <dir> --dist <dist> prints the link message then 'Please report this to https://github.com/markedjs/marked.', exit 1 (sha c8d0ebf)
solution: renderBody calls the unwrapped marked.parser(marked.lexer(markdown)) with plain throws
symptom: The documented message gains a second line pointing at the marked issue tracker
title: Link errors carry marked's 'Please report this' suffix
